notes: SqyWire is a portable Rydberg-atom QRF receiver leveraging Cs/Rb vapor cells. Demonstrated at Army C5ISR NetModX23 at Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst NJ (open-air tests). Operates HF through SHF (3 MHz - 30 GHz+). Integrated with SINCGARS tactical radio and electronic warfare sensor. Three-step process: laser excitation to Rydberg state, RF field perturbs energy levels, optical detection. Sugar-cube size claim (~1 cm^3 active element). Marketing language 'collapses km-long antennas to sugar cube' is plausible for narrowband EIT but bandwidth vs sensitivity tradeoff is real. No independent peer-reviewed sensitivity numbers published for SqyWire specifically as of 2026-04-26. Army 2023 field test showed operational integration but did not publish quantitative sensitivity floor.
